title: Fr3on
features:
Title: Multi-Feature Roblox GUI Script

Description:
This is an advanced LocalScript for Roblox that creates a customizable GUI with various features to enhance gameplay. The script includes:

✅ Customizable UI: A draggable window with title bars, buttons, and side menus.
✅ Player Controls: Modify walk speed, jump power, fly mode, and noclip mode.
✅ Teleportation & Targeting: Search for players, teleport to them, follow them, and even view them in third-person mode.
✅ Interactions: Sit on players, hug them, or perform special animated actions.
✅ Security Features: Anti-sit protection and other player protections.
✅ Donation Feature: Includes a Pls Donate integration to support the developer.

This script is designed for Roblox game environments and is intended to enhance player control, movement, and interaction while keeping the interface user-friendly.
